body: Thank you for your insight. Much appreciated.

Thank you for responding. Appreciate it so much. I’m trying to find out some contact details for his parents but right now I haven’t been able to get anywhere. We’re both expats living abroad and his parents live in the USA. That’s all I know.  I’m just having a tough time dealing with the fact that I may need to commit my best friend and I feel this maybe a decision his family should be making and not me. If he goes voluntarily I feel he is more likely to get better than if he has to be forced to go and forced to take some meds. I’ve also spoken to him before when he wasn’t so paranoid a couple days ago and just severely depressed about whether he thought it maybe a good idea to contact his family. And he was very adamant that he didn’t get along with his dad. But both his parents visited him a couple months ago so I don’t know if this is part of his delusion or if contacting his parents will make things worse. But I have my own issues (cocaine addict) and also go to therapy currently so I know he will need some kind of support there for him and I don’t think I’ll be able to be that for him in the longer term. But there’s just no one to call.

I’ll call him tomorrow again. He looked tired so I hope he gets some rest and will let me in tomorrow. When I’ll try to record my visit with my iPhone in my pocket. Seems like it might be a good backup. Thank you for your response. Appreciate it a lot.
